description: Repères de crue is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Sécurité intérieure. Le ministère de la Sécurité intérieure (MSI) soutient le développement de la connaissance des risques liés aux inondations. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de la Sécurité intérieure. Its tags are Décrue, Délaissé de crue, Eau, Inondation, Niveau. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, SHP, WFS. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
